summary: Read-only list of the game's smithing and alchemy recipes. Each is { id, kind, uiName, perks, ingredients, products }. Smithing adds category, workpiece, minSkill and dlcId, and alchemy adds base, number and xp. Players know a recipe through a perk, and Player.learnRecipe, forgetRecipe and knowsRecipe take these ids.

all.summary: All recipes, or those of one kind.
all.exampleLua:
for _, recipe in ipairs(kcds.world.Recipe.all("alchemy")) do
  print(recipe.id, recipe.uiName)
end

get.summary: One recipe by id, or null.
get.example:
const recipe = kcds.world.Recipe.get(recipeId);
if (recipe) console.info(recipe.kind, recipe.products);
get.exampleLua:
local recipe = kcds.world.Recipe.get(recipeId)
if recipe then
  print(recipe.kind, recipe.products)
end
